verdict.rationale: Avalara documents a Managed Returns API that embeds tax return preparation and filing, plus VAT Reporting for preparing and submitting VAT obligations. That evidence describes companion products rather than core AvaTax, which matches a community note that AvaTax alone still needs filing handled separately. missing for 10: automatic remittance of funds, documented coverage of every registered jurisdiction, on-time filing commitments, a vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, returns are prepared, filed, and remitted automatically in every registered jurisdiction — on time, with the vendor's guarantee covering penalties if it files late

citations.quote: Avalara Managed Returns API enables partners and platforms to embed tax return preparation and filing into their workflows.
VAT Reporting helps businesses manage the preparation and submission of value-added tax (VAT) obligations across jurisdictions.
